fec_collection_selection.observation_ordinal: Zero-based observation order within this dataset generation. Repeated observations remain separate; this is not a publisher record identifier.
fec_collection_selection.record_id: Deterministic identity of this collection/member policy decision, binding the source generation and equivalence evidence; not a financial transaction key.
fec_collection_selection.policy_version: Exact named/versioned selection or association policy responsible for this decision.
fec_collection_selection.purpose: Named analytic purpose of this representation-selection policy: a retained reported snapshot, not a current or net money total.
fec_collection_selection.collection_id: Exact retained collection label. Join fec_collections in the selected source generation; the label alone is not a globally unique source identity.
fec_collection_selection.source_generation_pin: Exact sealed source generation used for this decision or association; binds the source namespace and evidence lookup.
fec_collection_selection.source_sha256: SHA-256 of the original source witness bytes; distinct from the typed table's publication digest.
fec_collection_selection.source_member_name: Literal archive member name participating in the proven representation selection.
fec_collection_selection.selected_collection_id: Collection chosen to represent this proved source population once; not a replacement of the retained original evidence.
fec_collection_selection.selection_status: Explicit inclusion, equivalent-representation or unresolved selection outcome under the named policy.
fec_collection_selection.selection_reason: Reason the policy selected, excluded as an equivalent representation, or refused this source collection.
fec_collection_selection.equivalence_evidence_sha256: Digest of the retained row-multiplicity equivalence proof used for representation selection; counts alone are insufficient.
fec_collection_selection.current_record_status: Explicit current-selection limitation or decision. Capture order and a mapped value alone do not establish the current record.
fec_collection_selection.correction_applicability_status: Whether the captured correction can be applied to an evidenced base and target population; unresolved applicability prevents a qualified current total.
fec_collection_selection.source_member_ordinal: Native zero-based archive member ordinal, retained with its exact member name and source digest.
fec_collection_selection.source_observations: Exact count of native observations covered by this collection selection decision; not a monetary total.

fec_filing_definition_evidence.target_table: Typed table containing the evidence or association target; target_record_id is scoped to that table and resolved generation.
fec_filing_definition_evidence.target_record_id: Exact typed observation key supported by this witness or filing association; not a native source ID.
fec_filing_definition_evidence.target_generation_scope: Whether the target is in this containing generation or an external generation. A self reference resolves through publication metadata, avoiding a self-hash cycle.
fec_filing_definition_evidence.witness_generation_scope: Whether witness coordinates resolve within the containing or an explicitly pinned external source generation.
fec_filing_definition_evidence.witness_generation_pin: Exact already-sealed generation pin for an external witness; not inferred from the latest publication pointer.
fec_filing_definition_evidence.role: Role of this witness in supporting the target, such as primary source, header, source definition or context.
fec_filing_definition_evidence.endpoint_kind: Evidence endpoint kind: source_record resolves a row, while collection_context resolves an exact column and pointer in fec_collections.
fec_filing_definition_evidence.collection_id: Exact retained collection label. Join fec_collections in the selected source generation; the label alone is not a globally unique source identity.
fec_filing_definition_evidence.source_record_id: Native source-observation key within collection_id. Resolve with the source generation, exact locator and source digest, not this value alone.
fec_filing_definition_evidence.context_column: Column of fec_collections holding this context witness; NULL for a source-record endpoint.
fec_filing_definition_evidence.context_pointer: Exact JSON pointer inside context_column to the retained source fact or definition; does not create a fictional source record.
fec_filing_definition_evidence.witness_sha256: Digest of the original bytes supporting this witness, which may differ from the primary financial row's digest.
fec_filing_definition_evidence.witness_locator_json: Native source coordinates of the witness, including worksheet cells, source row address or definition location.
fec_filing_definition_evidence.observation_ordinal: Zero-based observation order within this dataset generation. Repeated observations remain separate; this is not a publisher record identifier.

fec_filing_header_associations.record_id: Deterministic identity of this header-to-filing association decision under policy_version, separate from both endpoints.
fec_filing_header_associations.policy_version: Exact named/versioned selection or association policy responsible for this decision.
fec_filing_header_associations.target_table: Source endpoint table for the original-file header; fec_source_records is resolved in source_generation_pin.
fec_filing_header_associations.target_record_id: Native header source_record_id within collection_id and source_generation_pin, verified by the source locator and digest. This endpoint is not a typed financial record key.
fec_filing_header_associations.source_generation_pin: Exact sealed source generation used for this decision or association; binds the source namespace and evidence lookup.
fec_filing_header_associations.collection_id: Exact retained collection label. Join fec_collections in the selected source generation; the label alone is not a globally unique source identity.
fec_filing_header_associations.source_record_id: Native source-observation key within collection_id. Resolve with the source generation, exact locator and source digest, not this value alone.
fec_filing_header_associations.source_sha256: SHA-256 of the original source witness bytes; distinct from the typed table's publication digest.
fec_filing_header_associations.source_authority: Authority assigned to the selected source, preserving official FEC, unofficial originals and third-party research distinctions.
fec_filing_header_associations.source_locator_json: Exact source row or subrecord coordinates, including available member, ordinal, byte span and field-definition references. Resolve in the pinned source generation.
fec_filing_header_associations.association_basis: Evidenced basis for the filing association, such as a matched original URL or qualified native file number.
fec_filing_header_associations.association_status: Resolution outcome for this association; ambiguous and missing filing targets remain explicit.
fec_filing_header_associations.referenced_filing_key: Qualified filing key derived from the supported native reference even when no retained target resolves.
fec_filing_header_associations.filing_key: Nullable authority- and namespace-qualified filing-version key. Several retained observations can share it; group proven filing identity before joining.
fec_filing_header_associations.selection_evidence_sha256: Digest of the retained selection evidence used to authorize this mapper's source scope; not a financial inclusion decision.
fec_filing_header_associations.namespace_evidence_sha256: Digest of verified source definition evidence establishing the filing-number namespace used by the association.
fec_filing_header_associations.report_number_raw: Literal source value before conversion for report_number. Preserves spelling, signs and empty values; the typed value and its status are separate.
fec_filing_header_associations.header_record_id: Source-record identity of the actual filing header used by this association; it is not itself a filing-version key.
fec_filing_header_associations.header_locator_json: Exact native address of the associated filing header in the selected source generation.
fec_filing_header_associations.request_url: Captured request URL used as association evidence, without a fresh network request.
fec_filing_header_associations.resolved_url: Captured resolved URL retained separately from the request URL; an exact supported URL match is required for an original-file association.
fec_filing_header_associations.replacement_mode: Evidenced amendment replacement mode, such as complete, partial or unknown. A filing link alone does not prove delete-by-omission behavior.
fec_filing_header_associations.membership_completeness: Whether all records in the amendment/replacement scope were established; unknown scope cannot justify removing omitted rows.
fec_filing_header_associations.current_record_status: Explicit current-selection limitation or decision. Capture order and a mapped value alone do not establish the current record.
fec_filing_header_associations.filing_observation_count: Number of candidate filing observations examined for this association; association_status states whether they resolve to one supported filing identity.
fec_filing_header_associations.filing_observation_ids: List of all candidate fec_filings.record_id values retained by the association, including unresolved/conflicting candidates; expanding it changes row cardinality. Stored as native nested values; list order, repeated values, null and empty collections remain distinct.
fec_filing_header_associations.observation_ordinal: Zero-based observation order within this dataset generation. Repeated observations remain separate; this is not a publisher record identifier.
fec_filing_header_associations.filing_association_status: The maintained association rule result. Resolved means a qualified filing key; unresolved reasons and not_evaluated never imply an edge or a current filing.
fec_filing_header_associations.filing_association_policy: Version of the maintained filing association rule used for this decision.
fec_filing_header_associations.filing_association_source_generation_pin: Exact selected source generation used for the filing association decision.
fec_filing_header_associations.filing_association_target_generation_pin: Exact selected filing-metadata generation against which this association was checked.
fec_filing_header_associations.filing_association_record_id: Identity of the admitted association witness; null when source context or a singular header witness is unavailable.
fec_filing_header_associations.filing_association_referenced_key: Qualified filing key stated by a supported source reference, before checking retained targets. Null when the reference cannot be qualified.
fec_filing_header_associations.filing_association_target_count: Number of observed filing-metadata witnesses for the qualified reference. Null means the target population is not established; no witness is selected as latest.
fec_filing_header_associations.filing_association_target_record_ids: Every matching filing observation identifier in the selected target population, preserving repeated witnesses. Null means the population is not established. Stored as native nested values; list order, repeated values, null and empty collections remain distinct.
